name: sizecurve-video
description: A motion explainer for Sizecurve (cider2's Shopify app), edited in Remotion. Media, renders and node_modules are not in git. node_modules is a link to ../camein-video/node_modules (same versions); run npm install there, or replace the link with a real install.

scripts.render: node gen-music.mjs public/music.wav && remotion render src/index.jsx Explainer out/sizecurve-explainer.mp4 --concurrency=6 --timeout=90000
